config.displayLanguage.description: Language for BDD Guardian messages (toasts, status bar, hover). Use 'en' for English, 'es' for Spanish. If not set, follows VS Code display language.
config.feedbackLevel.description: Visual feedback density for step binding status. Preset is a ceiling; individual toggles can still turn channels off.
config.feedbackLevel.full: Gutter + border + Problems + CodeLens (default, same as pre-v1.9)
config.feedbackLevel.standard: Gutter + Problems + CodeLens (no border / overview ruler)
config.feedbackLevel.minimal: CodeLens only (Go to Definition still works)
view.suiteMap.name: BDD Map
config.suiteMap.enabled: Show the BDD Map view in Explorer (workspace unbound / ambiguous / orphan holes). Independent of feedbackLevel.
